Elena Popescu 102  
Bengaluru, India | +91 9876543210 | elena.popescu@nexainights.com | linkedin.com/in/elena-popescu-data-science  

Professional Experience  
At Nexa Insights, I’ve focused on refining predictive models to support rapid product iterations. My role involves leading feature engineering pipelines, mentoring junior data scientists in Bayesian methodologies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to operationalize statistical models. Prior to this, I spent five years at InsightLabs, where I designed scalable workflows for real-time data analysis and integrated MLOps practices to streamline model deployment. Earlier, at DataVolve, I transitioned from data analysis to building machine learning systems, emphasizing rigorous exploratory data analysis to uncover actionable insights. My career began at AnalyticsWorks, where I developed a foundation in translating raw data into strategic recommendations for growth-oriented startups.  

Projects  
A key initiative at Nexa Insights involved optimizing customer segmentation using Bayesian hierarchical models, which improved targeting accuracy by 18% compared to prior approaches. This work required meticulous feature engineering to account for regional market dynamics. At InsightLabs, I led a project to automate anomaly detection in user behavior data, leveraging Pandas for efficient data manipulation and statistical modeling to flag outliers. The solution reduced manual review time by 30% while maintaining high precision.  

Professional Summary  
With over 15 years in data science, I’ve prioritized building robust analytical frameworks that align with business objectives. My work spans from foundational data analysis to advanced statistical modeling, with a focus on creating interpretable insights in dynamic startup environments. I’ve mentored several data scientists in Bayesian techniques and contributed to the design of scalable data processing pipelines. My approach balances technical rigor with practical application, ensuring models are both statistically sound and operationally viable.  

Education  
Master of Science in Data Science, University of California, Berkeley (2010)  

Technical Skills  
Python is integral to my workflow, particularly for automating data pipelines and implementing statistical models. I frequently use Pandas for data manipulation and NumPy for numerical computations, often combining these tools to preprocess datasets for machine learning. My expertise in Bayesian statistics has influenced architecture decisions, such as incorporating prior knowledge into predictive models. Exploratory data analysis remains a cornerstone of my practice, guiding hypothesis generation and model refinement. Feature engineering is approached methodically, with a focus on domain-specific insights to enhance model performance. MLOps practices are embedded in my work, ensuring seamless integration of models into production systems. Apache Spark is occasionally used for distributed data processing, though my primary tools remain Python-centric.  

Certifications  
Advanced Machine Learning Certification, Stanford Online (2019)
